item.title: Reshaping Collections: Where History Meets Art - Espace art actuel
item.description: As I walked through Vancouver’s Chinatown on an overcast afternoon, I noticed the street’s layered tensions. Closed storefronts, uneven sidewalks and visible homelessness appeared alongside traces of long-standing community life. Searching for the Chinese Canadian Museum, I began to think about how an institution devoted to historical preservation positions itself within a neighbourhood being shaped through precarity and gradual renewal,...
